findings.evidence: `DegreeImage.lean:96` proves `(weightedDegreeClass w h).range = AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range w)`, while `DegreeImage.lean:108` and `DegreeImage.lean:135` still assume `{x₀ : X} (hx₀ : w x₀ = 1)`.
findings.fix: State these APIs with the natural hypothesis `AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range w) = ⊤` (or equivalently a surjectivity hypothesis for `weightedDegreeClass w h`) and derive the weight-one versions, if wanted, as corollaries.
findings.issue: `weightedDegreeClass_range_eq_top` and `classGroupQuotientPicZeroEquivInt` require a point `x₀` with `w x₀ = 1`, but line 96 proves the nearby stronger criterion `(weightedDegreeClass w h).range = AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range w)`; weights can generate all of `ℤ` without any weight-one point, e.g. weights `2` and `3`.

summary: The general image computation is at the right level, but the exported surjectivity/quotient-to-ℤ APIs unnecessarily specialize back to the weight-one case.
